route_reason: The image is an illustrated scene (wall, ground, ladder) that must carry exact measurements (10 m and 60°), so it fits the layered route rather than plain geometry or illustration.

spec.wall: vertical brick wall on the right side, illustrated
spec.ground: flat ground line extending left from the base of the wall
spec.ladder: straight ladder from the ground leaning against the wall, touching the wall at its upper end
spec.angle_marked: 60° between the ladder and the ground, at the foot of the ladder
spec.style: clean, simple, labelled diagram with an illustrated brick wall

must_show: An illustrated brick wall standing vertically on the right and a flat ground line. A ladder leans from the ground against the wall, labelled 10 m along its length. The 60° angle between the ladder and the ground is marked at the foot of the ladder. The height where the ladder touches the wall is not labelled.
must_not_show: any value for the height or the wall's distance from the ladder foot
